comment: Exact pins for the termux .deb build. Bump all together: termux-deb versions -> debUrl + debSha256 -> wheel platformTag/ABI. Interpreters come from the termux-main apt pool as digest-pinned .debs (extracted, not built — upstream package-builder is amd64-only). Resolved 2026-08-31.

python.note: Termux CI-built CPython, pinned exactly (url+sha256 from the signed termux-main index, resolved 2026-08-31). Extracted into the payload — the phone python stays untouched. Upstream package-builder is amd64-only, so recipe-build on our arm lane is out; consuming their artifacts is the vetted-supplier call.

node.note: Termux CI-built nodejs-lts, pinned exactly. Same extract-into-payload shape as python.

wheel.note: Single source for the PEP 738 android platform tag used by termux_build.sh (retag target and index.json). pythonAbi (cp<major><minor>) is derived at build time from python.version, not stored here.

toolchain.note: setuptools matches pyproject.toml [build-system] requires (setuptools==83.0.0); the others are the versions used to build sdists in the wheelhouse that need them.
